does_not_rewrite: All historical DSC+HD95 evidence, decisions and artifacts (G5 select_M, G7.5 G75_RETAIN_BASELINE, G7.6 G76_RETAIN_C0) remain valid as recorded under the utility in force at the time. They are marked historical/superseded ONLY for current official-metric release selection.

reason.detail: The official BraTS 2026 Task 3 ranking aggregates global DSC and global NSD. The project's recorded award utility used DSC + HD95. HD95 is not an official Task-3 ranking metric.
reason.not_authorization_for: open-ended tuning, new thresholds, architectures, post-processing, ensembles, losses, or training experiments
reason.candidate_source_restriction: ONLY candidates that already existed before the Stage G7.7 prompt

official_metric_definition.hd95_role: SECONDARY_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY - never used to select the release policy
official_metric_definition.subject_aggregation: pandas DataFrame.mean(numeric_only=True) over per-subject rows, i.e. arithmetic mean with skipna=True; NaN entries are excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator, so per-component denominators may differ
official_metric_definition.failed_case_handling: subjects whose evaluator record carries an 'error' key are SKIPPED entirely (never penalised to the worst value)
official_metric_definition.missing_case_handling: subjects listed in 'missings' are filled with 0 for non-HD95 metrics (373 for HD95) - a missing PREDICTION is penalised, a failed METRIC is not

nsd_tolerance.evidence: panoptica/metrics/normalized_surface_dice.py emits: 'The threshold is set to 0.5, which is the default value'
nsd_tolerance.residual_uncertainty: BraTS-evaluation pins only panoptica>=2.1.0 with no upper bound, so a different panoptica version on the organizers' side could use a different default. This is recorded as an open question for the organizers and is NOT resolved by this stage.

bootstrap.delta_definition: delta = rank_candidate - rank_baseline; POSITIVE favours the baseline

design.award_utility: mean fractional rank over the six official components, equally weighted

definitions.C0: baseline: checkpoint_final, no TTA, no ET cleanup (the currently frozen release policy)
definitions.C2: checkpoint_final with the previously defined mirroring TTA
definitions.C3: checkpoint_best with the previously defined mirroring TTA
definitions.C0_et10: C0 with the already-predeclared ET-cleanup at 10 mm^3
definitions.C0_et25: C0 with the already-predeclared ET-cleanup at 25 mm^3
definitions.C0_et50: C0 with the already-predeclared ET-cleanup at 50 mm^3

candidates.regeneration_rule: Use preserved predictions wherever possible. Regenerate ONLY missing predictions for an already-authorised candidate and only within the stage ceilings. S1/S2 must NOT be regenerated if their cached predictions are absent - report the absence honestly instead.

architecture_diagnostic.purpose: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY under the official metric
forbidden: changing the architecture in this stage
spending additional GPU budget on L
architecture_diagnostic.reversal_rule: If the official-metric fold-0 diagnostic robustly reverses the architecture decision, STOP and return G77_ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; a new owner prompt is required.

per_policy_evaluation_gates_all_required: exact subject-set equality with the frozen fold membership
full expected denominators (subject count) before NaN-skipping
no case-ID or per-case leakage into any committed artifact
candidate_advances_iff: mean fractional rank gain over C0 on the six OFFICIAL components >= 1/6
paired bootstrap 95% interval EXCLUDES a tie in the candidate's favour
no fail-closed evaluation failure and no output-contract failure
advancement_rules.if_multiple_advance: advance ONLY the strongest by (1) official award rank gain, then (2) stronger bootstrap bound, then (3) the candidate closest to the frozen baseline. Do NOT open a new search.
advancement_rules.confirmation_rule: The single advancing candidate is evaluated against C0 on locked folds 3-4 exactly once. The release policy changes ONLY if confirmation independently passes the same gates. Otherwise retain C0.

claims_forbidden: official validation performance or leaderboard rank
any statement that these calibration/confirmation figures are unbiased estimates of deployed-ensemble performance
